reason: Nobody in my Telegram mom group or at the kindergarten has mentioned Kiddo yet, and I don't pay for an app nobody I know has tried. At most I would download the free version on Wi-Fi and see if my child even opens it while the grandparents watch him.
objection: Our internet is slow and limited, so I worry the download is big, and I don't know if the Uzbek voice and lessons are good or just another cartoon game.
would_change_my_mind: A few mothers in my Telegram group or the kindergarten teacher saying their child really learned letters with it.
